parent_objective: tail action sequence amplification diagnostic design

public_gates: design a diagnostic gate that can force or replay short wrong-tail action sequences without changing actor inputs
separate quick recurrent correction from non-outcome-sensitive pair selection
define variants and thresholds before implementation
do not train or promote checkpoint
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat forced action replay as deployable self-ID proof
do not add privileged actor inputs
do not skip normal wrong_tail_once and reset/zero-current controls
hypothesis: A short-horizon wrong-tail action sequence diagnostic can distinguish whether M487/M488 failed because wrong hidden is corrected too quickly or because the selected pairs are not outcome-sensitive even under forced wrong actions.
success_criteria: define wrong_tail_action_replay_K and wrong_tail_hidden_hold_K variants for K in {2, 4, 8, 12}
define how to compare them with wrong_tail_once reset_tail and zero_current_tail controls
define source-diversity and event/proof thresholds for a later implementation run
classify forced-action rows as diagnostic only, not deployable proof
failure_criteria: design cannot distinguish quick correction from non-sensitive pairs
design treats forced action replay as final self-ID proof
training or checkpoint promotion is proposed before the diagnostic gate

commands.name: tail_action_sequence_amplification_design
commands.command: Write the M489 diagnostic design and M490 implementation manifest; no training.

decision_rule: M489 should admit an implementation only if the diagnostic explicitly separates forced wrong-action sufficiency from natural wrong-hidden proof.
